pages.text: Boss of roots. Summoned with an Hourglass Idol, or rarely when murdering his children (1% chance normally). 226 HP, 9 damage. It even has its own boss music now! This boss has two special moves: the Special Sand Attack, dropping sand on your head (dealing more damage than usual!) & slowing you down. Lightning Attack: Summons Lightning, dealing 5 damage, burns, and slows you down. That means it is somewhat destructive. Not very much, but if you really care, avoid spawning it near your buildings. A random desert sounds like a good idea.
